152893.overview: While on a reconnaissance flight, your ship has been drawn by a Graviton Beam onto an Alien Cruiser. Fred, your pet android, informs you that the cruiser is on a Humanoid slave mission, its aim to seek out Humanoid planets from which samples are taken and their brains replaced by microchips. Your aim is to free your ship by pressing the control button in the main computer room. Of course, expect various hazards and puzzles to be in your way. The game features a simple 'Verb Noun' command interface, and no graphics of any description. Instructions such as 'insert key into hole' have to be split into two commands.

203648.overview:
Space Invaders is a clone of the arcade game where you move a craft, left or right at the bottom of the screen blasting a formation of aliens above. The aliens above move left and right, dropping bombs slowly descending the screen. In between yourself and the aliens are four shields, which lose parts every time you or the aliens hit one. If you are hit by an alien's bomb or an alien lands on the surface, then you lose one of three lives.

An early game by Jeff Minter of Llamasoft fame.

203649.overview: Another Space Invaders clone: move your gun left/right to hide behind shields, then shoot at the advancing ranks of aliens. Three speed settings (also when you beat a wave the speed of the next increases), player starts with three lives.

209059.overview:
Super Wumpus is an advanced version of Wumpus. The player is hunting a fictional Wumpus creature in a cave system. In this variant the rooms of the cave form a dodecahedron structure. 
 
The player can move around a cave system of twenty rooms and must try to hunt the Wumpus monster with arrows. The player can fire five arrows into rooms to try to hit the Wumpus and move between the various rooms. The arrows will fly around corners and can possibly hit the player again. The player can also be attacked by bats and fall into pit traps.

472589.overview:
Compilation of two arcade clones for the Sinclair ZX-81.

Super Glooper is a Pac-Man style of game where you must move around a maze, painting the floor as he goes while avoiding the chasing aliens.  The maze includes four shields that allow you to be invulnerable and temporarily destroy your alien foes if you collect it.

Frogs, on the other hand, is a Frogger variant where you must safely navigate a large river, jumping from log to log before reaching one of the safe zones on the other side of the river bank.
